## What this PR does

Add the initial project documentation, team charter, and project decisions for AI Boundary Board.

## Decision (required if a significant choice was made)

**Decision:** Develop AI Boundary Board as a collaborative tool for students to discuss and agree on when AI should or should not be used in group projects.

**Why:** Different students may have different opinions about AI usage. This tool aims to help team members compare their preferences, discuss disagreements, and record shared decisions.

**Alternative rejected:** Using only group chats or shared documents to discuss AI usage.

**Led by:** Kimi Jenson Tjan (曾健倫)
